official_definition: You can send two cores from any of your "Contractor Khaos" Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit. When you've done so, activate any number of (When Set) effect written on your Spirits/Nexuses/Mirage.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Chaos Unleash] or [Chaos Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Chaos Unleash]", "give [Chaos Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
